name: Poland
shortSummary: India-Poland ties carry historic goodwill from World War II, when Poland's Nawanagar state sheltered Polish refugees at "Little Poland" in Balachadi, and have grown through expanding trade and 2022 evacuation cooperation.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: The WWII-era Balachadi refuge remains a touchstone of the bilateral relationship.
Growing machinery and chemical trade alongside logistics cooperation.

recentDevelopments.title: Trade and logistics ties continue growing
recentDevelopments.description: India-Poland trade continued its steady growth trajectory, building on Poland's role as a logistics gateway to Central Europe.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A quietly expanding relationship without major friction points.

historicalEvents.title: Refuge for Polish Civilians at Balachadi
historicalEvents.description: The princely state of Nawanagar shelters hundreds of Polish refugee children and civilians fleeing World War II, an episode still commemorated by both nations as "Little Poland."

historicalEvents.title: Evacuation Transit Support
historicalEvents.description: Poland serves as a key transit point for Indian citizens evacuated from Ukraine under Operation Ganga following Russia's invasion.

multilateralRelations.detail: Poland is engaged as part of India's broader EU relationship.
